title: RoleMappingRule
description: Connection-scoped rule mapping IdP data to REAP roles.

connectionId.description: IdP connection that owns this rule.

enabled.description: If false, this rule is skipped.

match.description: Condition to evaluate against IdP-derived identity data.

source.description: Where to read from: normalized group set, an OIDC claim, or a SAML attribute.

path.description: When source=claim: JSON Pointer or dotted path. When source=attribute: SAML attribute name. Omit for source=group.

operator.description: equals = exact or array membership; contains = substring / any-element-contains; matches = regex.

value.description: Right-hand side string to compare against.
